title: CRMRecord
description: The CRM fields the agent is allowed to see, AFTER PII masking at the middleware boundary (BRD US-02). This schema deliberately excludes name, address, phone, email, DOB, and any other direct identifier — the agent should never receive them. If a future capability needs a direct identifier, that's a deliberate architecture decision requiring its own review, not a field quietly added here.

customer_id.description: Same internal identifier used in the OCS event stream — this is the join key between systems.

tenure_months.description: Months since the customer's account was opened. Used as a light-weight risk signal (very new accounts get extra scrutiny in Stage 2's reasoning).

contract_id.description: Join key into the Contract/RAG store. One customer to one active contract assumed by the POC — confirm this holds for multi-product/multi-line accounts in the real system.

prior_disputes_12mo.description: Count of billing disputes raised in the trailing 12 months. Directly lowers Stage 2's confidence score for ambiguous cases — a customer with a dispute history gets a more cautious read, not a more lenient one.

prior_goodwill_credits_12mo.description: Count of goodwill/auto-resolution credits already issued in the trailing 12 months. This is the field that gates repeat-goodwill abuse — Stage 2 will NOT auto-approve a first-occurrence-pattern charge if this is non-zero. Confirm the real CRM/Billing system can actually produce this count reliably; if goodwill credits aren't tagged distinctly from other credit types today, this needs a data-quality fix before Sprint 2, not just an API to call.
